Reviewed all 55 scenarios for product-first wording, one-trigger atomicity, actor and limitation coverage, lifecycle mapping, cross-cutting applicability, and decision completeness.

Successful Git staging is split into atomic single-move and batch scenarios, uses the existing Operator boundary, preserves unrelated worktree changes, and explicitly excludes dry-run, untracked, and non-Git moves.

Long-scan liveness is split into atomic interactive, JSON, and non-interactive scenarios, uses the existing Operator boundary, remains CLI-only by default, and is explicitly an interaction affordance rather than analytics or telemetry.
CommonJS interop behavior is split into atomic move and exported-identifier rename scenarios, uses the existing Operator boundary, and adds no new lifecycle or cross-cutting category.

Framework-dispatched entrypoint safety is explicit across built-in valid App Router locations, ordinary same-stem controls, caller-configured globs, human-readable advice, and structured CLI, MCP, and library results.

Package public API safety distinguishes confirmed root and subpath entrypoint reachability from private sibling exports, and separates unresolved entrypoint traces into an explicit unknown-usage outcome without destructive advice.
CLI stream lifecycle behavior separates the expected closed-stdout alternative exit from unexpected stdout and stderr failures, while remaining outside MCP and library surfaces.
The 33 source-backed V1/P1 scenarios now represent 60.0% of the V1 slice, below the priority-skew warning threshold, while the four launch-critical scenarios remain P0.

Reviewed ANLY-013..014 for issue #207: ANLY-013 states the product outcome that a package binary's tree stays live while explicitly denying it public API, and ANLY-014 keeps an unresolvable bin target non-destructive in line with ANLY-006. Reviewed SIM-001..003 for issue #208: similar shipped on all three surfaces with no scenario governing its verdicts, which is why a wrong-verdict defect had nothing to fail against. SIM-001 pins that real duplication is still reported at any declaration size, so the two suppression changes cannot be satisfied by silencing the command; SIM-002 states the withholding outcome; SIM-003 requires the reported verdict to match the evidence that produced it.
